source_text: The Ashley Montagu Resolution, adopted by acclamation at the Fourth International Symposium on Sexual Mutilations in Lausanne, Switzerland, on August 11, 1996, constitutes a petition to the World Court at The Hague declaring genital mutilations of children—encompassing both female and male forms—as violations of international human rights instruments. [2]
